updatedAt.description: When the managing AppView last changed.

managingApp.description: The managing AppView, named without a service fragment. Its DID document's #colibri_appview service is where requests about the community go.

main.description: Names the AppView that manages a community. Lives in the community account's public repository, so any AppView can find where to send requests about the community without being a member. Written by the managing AppView.
